correctness.rationale: Each cross-edge is examined only by its later endpoint, so conditional independence in a given side word is exact. The degree argument integrates E[1/(1+D)] = integral_0^1 (1−p+px)^n dx, giving the finite mean, even for p=1. Reconstructed the crucial variance independently by a Doob martingale: given the first i fair letters with counts A_i,B_i, the expected future sum of q^{opposite count} is (q^{A_i}+q^{B_i})/p. Thus the martingale increments take the two equally likely values ±(q^{A_i}−q^{B_i}) at the next position. Their squared expectations sum over i≥0 to 2 sum_i[((1+q²)/2)^i−q^i] = 2/(1+q). L² convergence of the conditional-expectation martingale follows from M in L² (Minkowski bounds its L² norm by the convergent sum of ((1+q²)/2)^((j−1)/2)). Therefore p[M(q)−M(q²)]→1 and sqrt(p)(M(q)−2/p)→0 in L². Conditional Bernoulli Berry–Esseen is valid for the countable sum by finite truncation; conditional variances are asymptotically 1/p in probability, and mixing this bound plus Slutsky proves the infinite model CLT. In the finite balanced word the next-step sign probability differs by at most (j−1)/(2(2n−j+1)); the matched-prefix probability therefore tends to one for K=ceil(20 log(1/p)/p). The finite tail bound uses Maclaurin on n weights q and n−1 weights 1 after conditioning on the side at j; both tails are O(p^9). The exact finite mean differs from 2/p by o(p^−1/2). Lemma 1 of the source applies to the specified recoloring rule, using reversal of the uniform ordering convention when needed. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed; its finite enumeration corroborates the conditional law, not the CLT.
